title: Lesson meta
description: Per-lesson metadata file for /content/lessons/<slug>/meta.json. Bundled at build time into the lesson index.

title.description: Display title in the curriculum index and lesson header.

slug.description: URL-safe id; MUST equal the folder name. Underscore-prefixed slugs are excluded from production builds.

order.description: Curriculum position; ascending sort key. Must be unique across lessons in the same build.

summary.description: One-line description shown under the title in the index.

estimatedMinutes.description: Author's best guess at completion time.
